Brief.title: Your Brief
Brief.lead: Roles that can hire you from {country}, each one seen live on the company's own board. You apply yourself — Pemby never applies for anyone.
Brief.leadNoCountry: Roles that can hire you, each one seen live on the company's own board. You apply yourself — Pemby never applies for anyone.

rail.label: What you're being shown
rail.count: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing on the table} one {# match} other {# matches}}
rail.note: Only posts that clear every check and score at least 80 reach this page. There is no feed behind it.
rail.held: {count, plural, one {# more is waiting on the 24-hour delay.} other {# more are waiting on the 24-hour delay.}}
rail.yellowHelp: Posts whose wording suggests {country} is included without saying so outright. They always stay labelled as likely.
rail.salaryHelp: You asked Pemby to keep these out. Turning them back on shows them with their pay line blank.

match.applyLabel: Open {title} at {company} in a new tab and mark it applied

held.label: Matches on the way
held.title: {count, plural, one {# match is waiting} other {# matches are waiting}}
held.body: Free accounts get every match 24 hours after the post was first seen, on every channel. The first of these arrives in about {hours}h.
held.bodySoon: Free accounts get every match 24 hours after the post was first seen, on every channel. The first of these arrives within the hour.
held.bodyNoTime: Free accounts get every match 24 hours after the post was first seen, on every channel.
held.pass: The role, the company and the link stay out of this page until then. A pass delivers each match the moment Pemby finds it.

sections.handledLead: What you applied to or passed on. It stays here so the same post doesn't come back around.
sections.nearMissLead: Each of these failed on one thing. Where a setting of yours is the one thing, the fix is one tap.

silence.title: Nothing cleared the bar today.
silence.body: Of everything Pemby checked, nothing both fits you and can hire you from {country}. That is the honest answer, and it is what this page says instead of filling itself.
silence.bodyNoCountry: Of everything Pemby checked, nothing both fits you and can hire you. That is the honest answer, and it is what this page says instead of filling itself.
silence.empty: Nothing came close either. Pemby keeps re-checking every open post; the next match reaches you on Telegram, email or web push without you opening this page.

nearMiss.groupLabel: Near misses by what blocked them

groups.eligibility: Can't be confirmed for your country
groups.way_of_working: Not a way of working you accept
groups.freshness: Not confirmed live in the last 24 hours
groups.score: Close, but under the score bar

nearMiss.fixYellow: {count, plural, one {# looks likely — include it?} other {# look likely — include them?}}
nearMiss.fixSalary: {count, plural, one {# has no pay listed — show it?} other {# have no pay listed — show them?}}
nearMiss.fixYellowDone: Likely matches are on. They join your Brief at the next check.
nearMiss.fixSalaryDone: Posts with no pay listed are on. They join your Brief at the next check.
nearMiss.noFix: No setting opens this group; the post itself would have to change.

programs.title: Your next step
programs.lead: Paid programs open to people in {country}. Every date comes from the program's own pages.
programs.leadNoCountry: Paid programs. Every date comes from the program's own pages.

pass.title: Why isn't it for you?
pass.note: Pemby scores the next ones with this. There is nothing to type.

flag.title: What's wrong with this post?
flag.note: Pemby acts on this automatically and re-checks the post. There is nothing to type.

valueTitle.salary: What does the post actually say about pay?
valueTitle.seniority: What level does the post actually ask for?
valueTitle.stack: Which one is not in the post?
valueTitle.location: Which location is not in the post?
valueTitle.eligibility: What does the post actually say about your country?

salary.not_listed: It lists no pay at all
salary.lower: The pay is lower than shown
salary.higher: The pay is higher than shown

eligibility.yellow: It hints at my country without saying it

empty.stack: The post lists no technologies, so there is nothing to correct here.
empty.location: The post lists no locations, so there is nothing to correct here.

errors.unauthenticated: Your session ended. Sign in again and the Brief comes back.
errors.forbidden: This account can't open the Brief.
errors.invalid_request: Pemby couldn't read that. Try the same tap again.
errors.match_not_found: That match is no longer in your Brief.
errors.job_not_found: That post is no longer in Pemby.
errors.flag_limit_reached: You've used today's reports. They reset tomorrow.
errors.unavailable: Pemby couldn't save that. Try again.
errors.network: No answer from Pemby. Check your connection and try again.
